VGM output is independent of the displayed Channel and Auto update. Muting does not invalidate an exact paused Capture ticket or mute the separate paused audition, authored Synth or Code sound.

Native PCM verifies all-On identity with the original player, isolation and summed output of all six channels, CH2-muted LFO carrier, continued CH2 phase while CH1 is muted, exact future PCM after unmute, Wave/Noise continuity and unchanged DAC stream observation.

Muted browser analyser confirms exact zero on the isolated left/right output, all-Off silence with progressing song position, Noise/DDA/LFO output, focus behavior, persisted flags and normal paused audition/Capture under all reference mutes.

Menu import, sound extraction and Wave / PCM keep-loudest-volume-variant remain available. Readable standalone modules, authenticated sources, existing WASM bytes, SDK 0.1.7, Master calibration and output graph are retained.
